info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v5-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Feedback Retrieval API allows users to access feedback associated with career applications effectively. This endpoint is particularly valuable for recruiters and HR personnel who require insights on candidate applications. Through this API, users can retrieve detailed feedback, facilitating a better understanding of candidate performance and selection criteria. The feedback can help enhance recruitment strategies and improve the overall hiring process.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch feedback associated with their applications. It returns a list of feedback entries, enabling users to evaluate and understand the responses provided on their applications.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to submit feedback regarding applications. The feedback should conform to the specified schema, reflecting the necessary details and structure required for processing.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the feedback application. It is expected to contain feedback data in string format.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksResponse.title: Feedback Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the feedback.

resultId.description: Identifier of the result associated with the feedback.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

audit.description: Details of the audit information for the operation.

ListCareersApplicationsFeedbacksResponse.description: Schema representing the response for the feedback operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the feedback was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the feedback was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information for the feedback response.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. This value indicates the efficiency of the server after receiving the request.
